closed_three_point_simplex.classification: common face: identical or reciprocal two-block likelihood ratios; different faces: equality iff supports are disjoint

attack_log: The first closed-simplex harness incorrectly compared TV with the intermediate rational chord envelope. It was rejected by p=(0,1/4,3/4), q=(0,1/2,1/2), which saturates the chord step but not the square-root Hilbert envelope.
The corrected harness compares TV with the square-root envelope through the exact squared identity (1-TV)^2 M >= (1+TV)^2 m, without floating-point approximations.
The first proposed strict example used two atoms. It was rejected because every two-atom likelihood ratio is automatically an endpoint, so the chord step saturates.
The corrected strict example uses three atoms and gives TV=1/3 < 3/7.
The complete harness was repeated under python -O; it uses explicit exceptions rather than assert.
